before_any_future_install: Record exact old package source SHA + Git blob SHA-1 of every existing app-owned installed file
Create SHA-256 preflight inventory of every existing Satellite recording/settings/TLE/cached tile and foreign app fixture WITHOUT moving/deleting
Obtain explicit owner authorization for a later installer/uninstaller
Keep old package artifact for rollback under independently audited non-user-data path
policy.future_rollback_method: Restore only the prior manifest-owned Satellite code/UI/shortcut files by exact hash, in a single reviewed package operation. Never delete user profiles or foreign app files. This JSON does not perform rollback.
allowed_when_reviewed: atomic installed package replacement of owned app binaries only
restore original Satellite-owned launcher names ONLY if exact ownership evidence is present
forbidden: modify Text Center shared SDR cooperative lock path
stop readsb/tar1090, Gqrx, welle.io or external SDR programs
use rm -rf user directory, broad app wildcard, sudo/service or driver changes
policy.retention: Existing Satellite data and third-party files preserved byte-for-byte; uninstall must not delete saved captures unless separately opted into by owner

pages.notes: PWA cache worker cleanup is scoped to satellite-webusb-shell-* and must never clear origin-wide data; no gh-pages change authorized
